mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal prostaglandin-mediated vasodilation and sodium excretion, antagonizing thiazide diuretic efficacy and increasing hyperkalemia/hyponatremia risk, while thiazides may elevate NSAID levels through volume depletion.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor blood pressure control, renal function, electrolytes, and consider alternative antihypertensive or analgesic; use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration.
